pages.text: $(bold)Key difference:$() Nether is $(t3)T3$() content. End is $(t4)T4$() content. Both are far more dangerous than vanilla.$(br2)$(bold)T2:$() Twilight Forest (boss-guarded progression, first uniques), Blue Skies (elemental combat bypasses armor), The Aether (aerial combat, doubled fall damage).$(br2)$(bold)T3:$() Undergarden (toxic attrition), Deeper and Darker (horror/stealth), The Nether (permanent aggro), The Abyss (optional).$(br2)$(bold)T4:$() Deep Aether (celestial events buff mobs), The End (3 escalating zones - the endgame).
